content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 5 gives us only legality, authority and non-infringement warranties, plus a disclaimer of all implied warranties — with no conformance warranty, no warranty period and no remedy anywhere in the Agreement (§ 4's acceptance/ownership provisions supply none). That fails the fallback, so I flagged a deviation and inserted a single new § 5(f): 90 days conformance to documentation for software/deliverables, 30 days professional-and-workmanlike performance for Services, remedied by repair, replacement or refund of fees paid. I targeted the fallback (not the preferred 12-month/malicious-code package) to keep the change minimal, and relied on the existing § 1(b) standard rather than adding a new performance standard.
